title: Reimagining Healthcare Learning: Technology, Experience, and the Future
summary: Explore how healthcare organizations are reimagining learning technology to deliver better experiences, drive engagement, and prepare the workforce for the future.
body_text: Healthcare education is entering a new era. Discover how AI is reshaping the way we learn, train, and grow. Join us for a 30-minute webinar where we explore how combining HealthStream solutions can boost workforce performance, engagement, and retention—giving your organization a strategic edge. We’ll showcase how the HealthStream Learning Center (LMS) supports compliance and regulatory training, while the new HealthStream Learning Experience (LXP) delivers personalized, AI-powered development. Key topics include: Understanding Innovations in Healthcare Learning: · How AI enhances content discovery, personalization, and learner engagement. · Real-world examples of learning experiences. LMS and LXP: What’s the Difference and Why It Matters: · LMS for compliance, certifications, and structured learning. · LXP for personalized growth, skill development, and career mobility. How HealthStream Bridges the Gap: · Seamless integration of LMS and LXP to support both regulatory and experiential learning. · Maximize workforce performance, engagement, and retention through the combination HealthStream solutions. ‍

title: Toyota Financial Services Expands Headquarters
summary: FRISCO, Texas (July 15, 2026) – Toyota Financial Services (TFS) this week began occupying a newly constructed 242,000-square-foot, seven-story building at its headquarters campus, capable of seating over 1,000 team members. This extension of the Toyota North America campus called […]
body_text: FRISCO, Texas (July 15, 2026) – Toyota Financial Services (TFS) this week began occupying a newly constructed 242,000-square-foot, seven-story building at its headquarters campus, capable of seating over 1,000 team members. This extension of the Toyota North America campus called “TFS North”, adds much-needed office space, additional parking, and facilitates the ability to co-locate larger teams. TFS team members supporting customer experience, dealer experience and data & technology will work out of this location. TFS North exemplifies thoughtful appreciation for team member well-being and productivity throughout the building. Recognized as one of the largest mass timber office spaces in the United States, the building’s commitment to health and sustainability is more than just a feature. The extensive use of Southern Yellow Pine timber creates a warm and inviting atmosphere. Tim Conlon, real estate senior manager, shared that one of the most exciting priorities in the design of TFS North was creating a space that feels open, welcoming, and connected. “The natural wood structure was intentionally highlighted, and wide-open views were preserved throughout the office to bring warmth and character into the workplace.” The overall result increases visibility, communication, and collaboration, helping team members feel more connected to one another and to the environment around them. Team members will enjoy a host of amenities, including a state-of-the-art gym and locker rooms, micro markets, furnished balconies, and a future restaurant. More subtle features include white noise systems that help reduce distractions and enhance concentration in open areas, window shades that adjust with the sun’s movement, and daylight harvesting that adjusts lighting to save energy. An adjoining 800-space parking structure makes for easy parking and EV charging. Plus, soon-to-be-installed space counters will make it easy for team members to find a parking spot. Alec Hagey, president and CEO of TFS, highlighted the advantages of the expanded office space, saying, “Our new building provides a modern environment where team members can come together to collaborate and provide the best possible service to our customers and dealers. As team members occupy this building, we will be able to reconfigure our existing headquarters space to reduce overcrowding, enhance collaboration, and foster innovation to position our company for future growth.” Additional TFS teams will continue to move into the space in the coming weeks with full occupancy anticipated in the fall of 2026. Related Media Related Images Share on Facebook Share on Linkedin Send email Copy Link About Toyota Financial Services Toyota Financial Services (TFS) is the brand for finance and related products for Toyota in the United States, offering retail auto financing and leasing through Toyota Motor Credit Corporation (TMCC) and Toyota Lease Trust. TFS also offers vehicle and payment protection products through Toyota Motor Insurance Services (TMIS). The company services Lexus dealers and customers using the Lexus Financial Services brand. As of March 31, 2026, TFS employed approximately 3,900 team members nationwide and had over $150 billion in assets. The company is part of a worldwide network of comprehensive financial services offered by Toyota Financial Services Corporation, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Toyota Motor Corporation. body_text: Share Share Share Conference: EANM 2026 Date: October 17 - 21, 2026 Location: Vienna, Austria Meet us there Meet Certara at EANM 2026 Certara is pleased to be participating in EANM 2026, where our experts will share the latest advancements in model-informed approaches for therapeutic radiopharmaceutical development. Whether you’re looking to optimize dose selection, strengthen your clinical development strategy, or discuss the application of quantitative science in theranostics, we’d welcome the opportunity to connect during the meeting. Poster presentations Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Modeling of Targeted Radiotherapies to Predict Absorbed Dose, Inform Next Generation Design, and Improve Therapeutic Index Authors: Joshuaine Grant, Ben Lang, Jamie Nosbisch, Amandine Manon, Diane-Charlotte Imbs, and Sarah Minucci A Semi-mechanistic Population Biodistribution Model of 89Zr-TLX250-Px for the Diagnosis of Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma Authors: Hunter Stephens and Mirjam Trame, in collaboration with Telix Meet our team Connect with Certara’s experts at EANM to discuss how integrated modeling, simulation, and regulatory science can help advance your radiopharmaceutical development program. From candidate selection and first-in-human studies to dose optimization, clinical development, and regulatory submissions, our multidisciplinary team provides quantitative strategies that support confident decision-making at every stage. Whether you’re developing diagnostic or therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals, we’d welcome the opportunity to discuss your specific challenges and explore practical, science-driven solutions tailored to your program. Submit the form to request a meeting with our experts during EANM and someone from our team will reach out to schedule. FAQs Where can I meet Certara at EANM 2026? Certara’s experts will be attending EANM 2026 in Vienna and are available to meet throughout the conference. Use the form on this page to request a meeting. Will Certara be presenting at EANM 2026? Yes. Certara has two accepted scientific posters highlighting quantitative approaches to therapeutic radiopharmaceutical development, including quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP) and population biodistribution modeling. Who should meet with Certara at EANM? We welcome conversations with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and radiopharmaceutical professionals involved in clinical pharmacology, translational medicine, pharmacometrics, quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP), dosimetry, regulatory strategy, and therapeutic radiopharmaceutical development. What can I discuss with Certara at EANM? Our experts can discuss dose optimization, first-in-human dose selection, pharmacometrics, quantitative systems pharmacology (QSP), biologically effective dose (BED), regulatory strategy, and model-informed drug development for therapeutic radiopharmaceutical programs. “ "Certara's integrated quantitative approach helped us make more informed development decisions by bringing together clinical pharmacology, modeling, and regulatory expertise." ” Additional resources Therapeutic Radionuclide Therapy (TRT) Solutions Page Pharmacometrics Modeling Services Clinical Pharmacology Consulting Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) Consulting Blog: Dosimetry Tells You the Dose. title: Refinity Partners with Zeton to Build a Repeatable Modular Plastic-to-Olefins Plant
summary: Refinity, an Innventure company, taps Zeton to design and build a 10 kta modular plant converting mixed plastic waste directly into circular olefins—a repeatable model for global deployment.
body_text: Partnership pairs Refinity's conversion technology with Zeton's modular fabrication expertise to accelerate the path from demonstration to commercialization ORLANDO, Fla., July 23rd, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Refinity, an Innventure, Inc. (NASDAQ: INV) company transforming hard-to-recycle plastic waste into valuable chemical intermediates, today announced it has selected Zeton Inc. to complete final detailed engineering plans for, and to build and deliver, a 10,000 tonne-per-annum (10 kta) modular waste plastics-to-olefins commercial demonstration plant. Zeton is a global specialist in the design and fabrication of modular pilot, demonstration, and production plants. This is an important step to advance Refinity's commercialization strategy of circular olefin production sited alongside third party petrochemical steam crackers, with Refinity to supply circular feedstock to the $300B ethylene and propylene markets, as well as the $400B polyethylene and polypropylene plastics markets. Zeton's modular, factory-built approach is expected to provide Refinity with a repeatable plant design required to scale the business. Refinity plans to site the 10 kta plant alongside a third-party petrochemical steam cracker to demonstrate circular olefin production at commercial conditions. The plant will run Refinity's fluidized bed conversion technology, which converts mixed plastic waste into light olefin gas streams, primarily ethylene and propylene, which will be fed directly into post-steam cracker operations. We believe this will be a first-of-a-kind commercial plant demonstrating direct conversion of mixed plastic waste to light olefins. Compared to processes that produce pyrolysis oil for use in steam cracking, we believe that our integrated approach will enable a two- to three-fold increase in yield from plastic waste to olefin products. In a second element of the collaboration, Zeton is contracted to build a unit designed to integrate with an existing fluidized bed system, supporting Refinity's scale-up capability for converting light gas products into jet-fuel-range liquids. This work is expected to advance a pathway central to Refinity's sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) strategy and complement the catalytic upgrading capabilities Refinity recently licensed from Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL). "Scaling a technology like ours is as much about execution as it is about chemistry," said Bill Grieco, CEO of Refinity. "We have deep collaborations with Dow, VTT, Pacific Northwest National Lab, and others. Working with Zeton is a natural next step as we believe Zeton's experience delivering modular process systems will help mitigate our scale-up risks and accelerate delivery of the 10 kta plant. Just as important, we anticipate replicating Zeton’s construction model in connection with our global commercialization strategy." Refinity anticipates completing initial production runs and validating practical operating costs as the modular systems are delivered and integrated. The engagement of Zeton is expected to help Refinity achieve its goal of creating a plant design that can be replicated globally at facilities located adjacent to steam cracker sites. About Refinity Refinity, an Innventure (NASDAQ: INV) company, converts difficult-to-recycle mixed plastic waste into drop-in raw materials for the petrochemical industry. Its proprietary DuoZone™ reactor platform targets the roughly 91% of plastic waste* that traditional mechanical recycling cannot handle, producing circular ethylene and propylene along with distillate liquids for sustainable aviation fuel and specialty markets. Refinity holds exclusive global licenses to breakthrough technologies and collaborates with trusted, well-respected partners across the petrochemical industry and leading research institutions. For more information, visit refinity.com. *Reference: United Nations Environment Programme, 2022. About Zeton Founded in 1986, Zeton Inc. is a global leader in the design and fabrication of modular pilot, demonstration, and production plants, with design-build facilities in Oakville, Ontario, Canada, and Enschede, the Netherlands. Zeton has completed more than 1000 projects worldwide across the chemicals, biofuels, and sustainable chemistry industries. About Innventure Innventure, Inc. (NASDAQ: INV), an industrial growth conglomerate, focuses on building companies with billion-dollar valuations by commercializing breakthrough technology solutions. By systematically creating and operating industrial enterprises from the ground up, Innventure participates in early-stage economics and provides industrial operating expertise designed for global scale. Innventure’s approach seeks to uniquely bridge the “Valley of Death” between corporate innovation and commercialization through its distinctive combination of value-driven multinational partnerships, operational experience, and scaling expertise.
